name: Optimize and diagnose computer hardware performance settings
description: Users sought technical advice to diagnose, configure, and optimize computer hardware and software performance for specific tasks such as gaming, virtualization, and development. Requests frequently involved comparing component capabilities, interpreting technical specifications or BIOS parameters, and troubleshooting driver or display settings to resolve performance bottlenecks.
